t: Can't Buy Love by Weston Parker | Goodreads
s: As a retired educator, I especially appreciated the details of what actually transpires in a third-grade classroom, including the preparation required by the teacher and the demeanor that insures a safe, nurturing environment for learning, dealing with difficult parents, and addressing the issue of bullying. But my favorite scenes in the book come when Alaina is walking Beau and having a conversation about her feelings and insecurities, and he actually responds. So adorable! Can’t Buy Love, a Grumpy to Sunshine Single Father Novel, is an unputdownable must-read!
